text_block_list.text: June was also nearing its end on this day—

Invited by Reporter Otonashi, I had come 
to watch the spring Grand Prix race, the 
Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With the title of this year's Grand Prix 
on the line, the Umamusume make their way 
onto the backstretch!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
The race favorite is Silence Suzuka-san. 
Ever since returning from Hong Kong, she's 
had one crushing victory after another.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"However, this time, your opponent is last 
year's Horse of the Year, Air Groove."

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
For Silence Suzuka-san, this race is a 
major turning point.

"A showdown between Silence Suzuka, who's 
currently riding a wave of momentum, and 
Air Groove, the Umamusume of the Year."

Considering her performance last year, I 
thought Air Groove had the upper hand, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now entering the homestretch, Silence 
Suzuka is in the lead! Air Groove is 
closing the gap rapidly from the outside!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
But here comes Silence! Silence Suzuka 
pulls off the wire-to-wire victory, 
crossing the finish liiine!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Winning without ever letting anyone 
pass, Suzuka is a great Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm amazed... To think you've 
developed enough strength to beat Air 
Groove-san...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
There's no doubt about it, Silence 
Suzuka-san is now a top-class 
Umamusume...!

Beyond her incredible skill, defeating the 
Umamusume of the Year, Air Groove, made it 
a truly memorable race...
